headline: The gold says Business Bronze ($900) is the best card for a $40,000 truck, but the KB's Silver Zoom triple-cash-back promo pays about $1,200; the gold holds only if that card is ruled out as logistics-only.

issues.summary: The gold compares only Business Bronze and Business Silver. Silver Zoom Card, a business card the user can apply for, has a triple cash back promo whose claim window is open today and that applies for 9 months from opening: 3 x 1.0% on non-category purchases gives $1,200 on $40,000 ($1,125.50 after the $74.50 fee), beating Bronze's $400 + $500 = $900. The only bar is the card being 'designed for' transportation/logistics businesses, which the docs never state as an eligibility rule. The persona even says 'expand your fleet'.
evidence: doc_business_credit_cards_silver_zoom_card_012: "You must claim the promotion within the window starting 2024-01-01 and ending 2025-12-31"; "The triple cash back earning period lasts 9 months from account opening"; "All other eligible purchases earn 3 × 1.0% during the promo period"
doc_business_credit_cards_silver_zoom_card_001: "Annual membership is $74.50"; "Who this card is built for - Established transportation and logistics operators"
doc_business_credit_cards_silver_zoom_card_008 lists only credit thresholds: "must be at or above $680" personal, "57 on the PAYDEX scale for logistics business approval"
doc_business_credit_cards_business_bronze_rewards_card_001: "Spend $10,000 in the first 2 months to receive a $500 statement credit"; Bronze rate 1.0%
gold[0].arguments.card_type = "Business Bronze Rewards Card"; required_documents list only Bronze and Business Silver docs
issues.why_it_matters: An agent that surveys all six business cards (Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Green Rewards, Silver Zoom) and computes returns recommends Silver Zoom; the user applies for it and the credit_card_applications row differs from the gold.
issues.suggested_fix: State an explicit industry eligibility rule in the Silver Zoom docs (or close its promo window before 11/14/2025), or change the purchase amount so Bronze still wins against a 3% promo.

solution_check: Returns on $40,000 (a vehicle is non-category for every card): Business Bronze 1% = $400 + $500 promo (window 2025-10-01..2026-03-31, $10,000 in 2 months) = $900; Business Silver 1%, x2 only if opening on 2025-11-14 counts within its promo end date, so $400-$800; Business Platinum 1.5% = $600; Business Gold 1% = $400 (a truck is not listed as operations spend), $200 fee; Green Rewards 1% = $400; Silver Zoom 3 x 1% = $1,200 under the open triple promo. Gold Bronze is correct only if Silver Zoom is excluded.
prior_note: Prior rated this None and did not consider Silver Zoom; the docs it relies on are unchanged since v1.0.0, so this defect existed before.
notes: Business Bronze's starting line is only "at least $10,000", so a $40,000 single purchase may not fit; no doc resolves this for any card. If an agent treated the truck as Transportation for Silver Zoom (3 x 3% = 9%), the gap would be larger still.
